paper_anchor: Theorem 4.4, HTML id S4.Thmtheorem4; stopping rule equation (3), paragraph S3.SS3.p2
statement: For fixed q in Q_bd and m0 in (0,1), under Assumption 4.1, sqrt(log(1/alpha)) (tau_alpha/log(1/alpha) - 1/KL_inf(q,m0)) converges in distribution to N(0, Var_q(ell(lambda*,X))/KL_inf(q,m0)^3) as alpha decreases to zero.
trend: KS and absolute centering error improve from b=2357.847 to b=10000 and versus b=4.605; variance ratio moves closer to one versus b=4.605.
negative_controls: Apply the b=10000 gate at paper alpha=1e-4
Normalize by fixed-sample sigma2 instead of sigma2_bd
verdict_policy: Finite simulation directly tests the paper setting and asymptotic direction but does not replace the theorem's proof for all q in Q_bd.
